showcase.user_prompt: 打开 Cowart 画布，把生成的图片放到画布上继续标注修改。
showcase.assistant_reply: 我会打开项目本地的无限画布，并让插件的 Skill 与 MCP 工具读写同一套画布文件。

items.title: 项目本地画布
items.description: 在活动面板中打开完整的 tldraw 工作区，画布数据保存在当前项目。

items.title: 插件内聚 MCP
items.description: Agent 工具和画布界面读写同一套 canvas 文件，保持内容一致。

items.title: 图像生成与编辑
items.description: 通过随包 Skill 从提示词生成图片，或根据画布标注继续修订。

items.title: 回到对话继续
items.description: 画布中的 AI 操作可向当前会话发送后续请求，延续工作流。

showcase.user_prompt: Open Cowart, place the generated image on the canvas, and continue with annotated edits.
showcase.assistant_reply: I’ll open the project-local infinite canvas and let the bundled Skills and MCP tools work on the same canvas files.

items.title: Project-local canvas
items.description: Opens a full tldraw workspace in the activity tab and stores canvas data in the project.

items.title: Plugin-scoped MCP
items.description: Agent tools and the canvas UI read and write the same canvas files.

items.title: Image generation and editing
items.description: Bundled Skills create images from prompts or revise them from canvas annotations.

items.title: Continue in chat
items.description: Canvas AI actions can send a follow-up into the current conversation.
